Title: Broken Drop
Description: The jump went horribly wrong. Heavy flak and high winds scattered the transport planes, missing the drop zone entirely. You have managed to rally only three other soldiers from your platoon. You are deep behind enemy lines, cut off from command, and supplies are critically low. Your only hope is to push through the occupation and link up with the main invasion army at either Cherbourg or Dieppe.

Title: Ambush in the Village
Description: German soldiers are dug in near a French village. They spot your squad approaching.

Options.ResultText: You retreat to a safer position, losing precious time and supplies in the chaos.

Title: Hidden Supply Cache
Description: You find a barn with hidden French resistance supplies.

Options.ResultText: You raid the cache. It's not stealing if it helps fight the occupation, right?
You leave the supplies for the local fighters. Hopefully, they put them to good use.

Title: The Bridge Must Hold
Description: You arrive at a key bridge. German forces are attempting to secure it.

Options.Text: Defend the bridge at all costs!

Options.ResultText: You rig the bridge to blow and pull back. It delays them, but costs you resources to reroute.

Title: Downed Allied Pilot
Description: In a field you find the wreck of a crashed Allied plane. The pilot is alive but injured.

Options.Text: Help the pilot and recruit him.
Options.ResultText: He's grateful and joins your squad, though treating his wounds uses up some supplies.

Options.Text: Take his supplies and move on.
Options.ResultText: You strip the wreck for useful gear. It's a cold decision, but survival comes first.

Title: Enemy Convoy on the Road
Description: A German supply convoy rumbles down a dirt road. They haven't spotted you yet.

Options.Text: Hide and wait for them to pass.
Options.ResultText: You stay low in the ditch. The trucks rumble past, unaware of your presence.

Title: Meeting with the Resistance
Description: A Resistance cell contacts you through a local farmer. They can offer food and ammo in exchange for your help.

Options.ResultText: You thank them but insist you must keep moving toward your objective.

Title: The Farmhouse
Description: You find an abandoned farmhouse. The door hangs open, and the air smells of gunpowder.

Options.ResultText: You scavenge what you can. A few cans of food and some ammo were left behind.
You circle around the property. Better to be safe than walk into a booby trap.

Title: Sniper on the Hill
Description: A German sniper is picking off anyone crossing the valley and is being protected by a squad of soldiers. You need to get through.

Options.ResultText: You take the long route through the dense woods, losing supplies but avoiding the shot.

Title: Running Low on Medical Supplies
Description: One of your men is badly wounded, and your morphine is almost gone.

Options.Text: Use your last medical kit to save him.
Options.ResultText: You use your last morphine. He stabilizes, but your medical stocks are dangerously low.
A heart-wrenching choice. You leave him with a weapon and move on. He is gone.

Title: Faint Radio Signal
Description: You catch a faint Allied radio transmission on a broken field radio.

Options.Text: Try to boost the signal and respond.
Options.ResultText: You manage to send a reply, but the effort drains your batteries and delays you.
Radio silence is safer. You ignore the transmission and keep moving.

Title: Captured Germans
Description: You come across a small group of surrendered German soldiers guarded by Resistance fighters.

Options.Text: Execute them quickly and move on
Options.ResultText: War is hell. You deal with the prisoners quickly and move out.

Options.Text: Argue to take them prisoner instead
Options.ResultText: You convince the partisans to spare them, but it costs supplies to secure them.

Title: Flooded Fields
Description: Low-lying farmland has been deliberately flooded to slow advances. It’s hard to move quickly.

Options.ResultText: The mud sucks at your boots. You make it through, but equipment is lost and ruined.

Options.Text: Wait until night to find a safer route.
Options.ResultText: You wait for darkness and better footing. It takes time, but you lose fewer supplies.

Title: Friendly Patrol
Description: You spot soldiers ahead and they seem to be wearing American helmets, but it’s hard to be sure at this distance.

Options.ResultText: They are from the 82nd Airborne! They are lost and happy to join forces.
You can't risk it being a trap. You let them pass, staying safe but alone.

Title: Displaced Civilians
Description: A group of French refugees approaches your camp. They are starving and beg for rations.

Options.ResultText: They weep with gratitude. You have less food, but you've done the right thing.

Options.Text: Turn them away, we need the food.
Options.ResultText: You harden your heart. You need every ounce of food to complete the mission.

Title: The Warning Sign
Description: You nearly step on a 'Achtung! Minen!' sign. The field ahead is rigged with explosives.

Options.Text: Have one of the soldiers clear a path carefully.
Options.ResultText: The soldier works with steady hands. A path is cleared without incident.
You decide not to risk it. The detour through the forest costs you time and supplies.

Title: Tiger in the Mist
Description: The distinct roar of an engine freezes your blood. A Tiger tank is idling in the clearing ahead.

Options.Text: Attempt to disable it with anti-tank gear
Options.ResultText: Before you manage to disable the Tiger you get spotted by a group of enemy soldiers. You manage to hastily escape but not without losing a member of your squad.

Options.Text: Stay low and crawl past it.
Options.ResultText: You crawl through the mud, holding your breath. The tank eventually moves on.

Title: The Supply Truck
Description: You find a German Opel Blitz truck in a ditch. The driver is gone, but the cargo bed is covered.

Options.ResultText: Jackpot. The truck is full of untouched rations and ammunition.
You take the fuel. It's not much, but everything helps.

Title: Suspicious Uniforms
Description: Soldiers wave you down from a farmhouse, but their boots don't match their Allied uniforms.

Options.ResultText: You run for the trees as bullets tear up the ground. Some of your men are hit.

Title: Torrential Downpour
Description: A sudden storm turns the dirt roads into thick mud. Movement is nearly impossible.

Options.ResultText: It's a miserable slog. Boots are ruined and supplies soaked, but you keep moving.

Options.Text: Set up camp and wait it out.
Options.ResultText: You hunker down. It costs time and rations, but the men get some rest.

Title: The Defector
Description: A lone German soldier emerges from the bushes with his hands up, offering a map case.

Options.Text: Accept the intel and let him go.
Options.ResultText: He provides accurate coordinates of enemy depots. The intel is valuable.

Options.Text: He's a spy. Take him out.
Options.ResultText: You can't risk it and execute him on the spot.

Title: Incoming Fire
Description: The whistling of artillery shells fills the air. They are bracketing your position.

Options.Text: Sprint out of the kill zone!
Options.ResultText: Explosions rock the earth. Shrapnel flies everywhere, wounding several squad members.
You dig in as shells pound the area. You survive, but gear is destroyed in the chaos.

Title: Sanctuary
Description: A bombed-out church stands ahead. A priest inside offers you clean water and bandages.

Options.ResultText: The sanctuary provides a brief respite. The squad feels rested and restocked.

Options.Text: Trade some ammo for extra food.
Options.ResultText: The priest accepts the ammo for food. A fair trade in these times.

Title: Roadblock
Description: A machine gun nest and a barrier block the only road forward.

Options.Text: Create a distraction to slip past.
Options.ResultText: You set a small fire to draw their attention. It costs resources, but you slip by.

Title: Mortar Spotters
Description: You spot a German mortar crew setting up in a ruined courtyard. They haven't fired yet, but they have a clear line of sight on the road ahead.

Options.Text: Rush them before they can dial in the range.
Backtrack and find a route out of their view.
Options.ResultText: You double back through the mud, wasting time but avoiding the deadly mortar fire.

Title: The Interrogation
Description: Ahead, a black staff car and two trucks block the road. Gestapo officers are aggressively questioning a group of terrified locals.

Options.Text: Ambush them to save the civilians.
Stay hidden and wait for them to leave.
Options.ResultText: You watch helplessly from the bushes. Eventually, they drive off, taking the civilians with them.

Title: Hanomag on Patrol
Description: The grinding of gears betrays a Sd.Kfz. 251 half-track patrolling the perimeter of the forest. It has a mounted machine gun.

Options.ResultText: The half-track rolls past, its spotlight sweeping just inches above your heads.

Title: Concrete Pillbox
Description: A small concrete bunker overlooks the valley entrance. The slit is narrow, but the MG42 inside covers the entire approach.

Options.Text: Use smoke grenades to screen a retreat.
Options.ResultText: You pop smoke and run. You escape, but you've used valuable tactical supplies.

Title: Forward Scouts
Description: A Kubelwagen scout car is parked on a ridge. Two officers are scanning the area with binoculars and have a radio.

Options.Text: Take them out before they use the radio.

Options.ResultText: It's slow, agonizing work, but you slip past their surveillance without alerting command.

Title: Hounds
Description: You hear barking. A German patrol with tracking dogs is moving through the woods, heading straight for your scent.

Options.Text: Wade through the icy stream to hide your scent.
Options.ResultText: The freezing water masks your trail, but the cold saps your squad's energy and ruins some rations.

Title: The Watchtower
Description: A hastily erected wooden watchtower with a searchlight sweeps the field you need to cross.

Options.Text: Shoot out the light and storm the tower.
Time your movement with the light.
Options.ResultText: You move in stop-start bursts. It takes hours to cross a few hundred meters.

Title: Young Conscripts
Description: You stumble upon a squad of Hitler Youth digging trenches. They are poorly equipped but fanatical.

Options.ResultText: You decide not to slaughter them, circling wide around the digging site.

Title: Refueling Station
Description: Two trucks are refueling at a small roadside depot guarded by a skeleton crew.

Options.Text: Sneak around the back of the depot.
Options.ResultText: The smell of gasoline is strong, but you manage to skirt the perimeter unnoticed.

Title: Street Fighting
Description: You enter a bombed-out town. A German squad is fortified in a bakery across the street.

Options.Text: Clear the building room by room.

Options.ResultText: The sewers are vile and infested with rats, but they get you past the bakery safely.

Title: High Value Target
Description: An unattended staff car sits outside a requisitioned manor house. An SS officer and his bodyguards are inspecting a map on the hood.

Options.Text: Don't press your luck, keep moving.
Options.ResultText: You leave the officer be. The mission is survival, not assassination.

Title: Screaming Mimi
Description: You hear the terrifying shriek of a Nebelwerfer rocket launcher nearby. The crew is reloading for another barrage.

Options.Text: Dig in and wait for the barrage to end.
Options.ResultText: The rockets scream over your heads. You survive the concussive blasts, but your hearing and morale take a hit.

Title: The Rail Line
Description: A supply train has stopped on the tracks. Guards are walking the length of the cars.

Options.Text: Climb over the coupling between cars.
Options.ResultText: You time it perfectly, slipping between the cars while the guards' backs are turned.

Title: Rogue Elements
Description: A group of soldiers in unkempt German uniforms are looting a farmhouse. They look like deserters, but they are heavily armed.

Options.ResultText: Desperate men are dangerous. You detour through the thorny brush to avoid them.

Title: Death from Above
Description: A shot rings out and hits the dirt near your feet. Snipers are tied into the trees ahead.

Options.Text: Sprint for cover and bypass the grove.
Options.ResultText: You run zigzag patterns until you clear the kill zone. It is exhausting.

Title: Off-Target Drop
Description: You find a supply canister swaying in the wind, caught high in an oak tree. It’s marked with Allied insignias.

Options.Text: Climb up and cut it down.
Options.ResultText: It takes some effort and a risky climb, but the canister crashes down. Inside, you find fresh medical kits and ammo.
You shoot the harness. The canister falls, but the impact damages some of the fragile medical supplies.

Title: The Wine Cellar
Description: The ruins of a chateau have a remarkably intact wine cellar. Someone has been using it to store more than just vintage Bordeaux.

Options.ResultText: Behind the wine racks, you find crates of grenades and preserved sausages.

Options.Text: Rest briefly and take a bottle.
Options.ResultText: A quick drink lifts spirits, but doesn't add much to your tactical supplies.

Title: Abandoned Ambulance
Description: A Red Cross truck sits in a ditch. The engine is dead, but the back might still hold supplies.

Options.ResultText: You find bandages, morphine, and sterile water. Exactly what the squad needed.
You find a map and a chocolate bar. Better than nothing.

Title: The Baker's Secret
Description: A local baker waves you into his shop. He reveals a false floor with supplies meant for the Maquis.

Options.ResultText: The baker fills your packs with fresh bread and stolen German rations.

Options.Text: Trade a weapon for extra food.
Options.ResultText: You leave a sidearm for his protection. He insists you take extra provisions in return.

Title: The Horsa Glider
Description: The wooden skeleton of a British Horsa glider lies in a field. It was carrying a jeep and supplies.

Options.ResultText: The jeep is wrecked, but the supply trailer is intact. You load up on ammo and fuel.
You use the wood to reinforce a bivouac, saving your own tents from wear and tear.

Title: The Goulash Cannon
Description: You stumble upon a German field kitchen (Gulaschkanone) left behind in a hasty retreat. The stew is still warm.

Options.ResultText: Hot food boosts morale and saves your own rations. You eat your fill.
It's messy to carry, but you manage to take some of the food with you.

Title: Overrun Command Post
Description: This was a temporary command post. Maps, radios, and a quartermaster's tent were left in the chaos.

Options.ResultText: You find high-quality officers' rations, batteries, and clean socks.
You find documents detailing supply drops. This leads you to a small cache nearby.

Title: The Whiteout
Description: A dense fog rolls in from the channel, reducing visibility to near zero. You can barely see the soldier in front of you.

Options.Text: Keep moving to stay on schedule.
Options.ResultText: You press on, but get disoriented. You end up walking in circles and losing gear in the confusion.

Options.Text: Halt and wait for it to lift.
Options.ResultText: You sit tight. It consumes time and rations, but the squad stays together.

Title: The Stray Cow
Description: A lone dairy cow is wandering through a shell-cratered field, seemingly unharmed.

Options.ResultText: It's grim work, but the fresh beef is a massive morale and supply booster for the squad.

Options.Text: Leave it be, it's too risky.
Options.ResultText: The noise or the time it would take isn't worth the risk. You move on, hungry but safe.

Title: Mud and Grit
Description: The constant crawling through mud has clogged the squad's rifles. They are liable to jam in the next fight.

Options.Text: Stop for a full cleaning session.
Options.ResultText: You use up your gun oil and cleaning patches, but the weapons are spotless.

Options.Text: Do a quick wipe and keep moving.
Options.ResultText: You wipe off the worst of the muck. Hopefully, it won't matter.

Title: The Burning Home
Description: You pass a French cottage engulfed in flames. You can hear coughing inside.

Options.ResultText: You drag an elderly couple to safety. They have nothing to give you but their thanks, and you suffered minor burns.
You can't save everyone. You avert your eyes and march past.

Title: Paper Rain
Description: The wind blows thousands of German propaganda leaflets across your path, urging Allied soldiers to surrender.

Options.ResultText: They make excellent fire starter for a smokeless fire to warm the squad.
You order the men not to read them. Rubbish, all of it.

Title: Escape to Cherbourg
Description: After weeks of evading enemy patrols, you reach the outskirts of Cherbourg. The thunder of naval guns shakes the ground and the Allies are assaulting the port. Smoke, chaos, and shouting fill the air as you make your final push toward friendly lines. For this final event you will be getting some reinforcements.

Options.Text: Charge through the docks to reach the Allied perimeter!

Title: The Battle for Dieppe
Description: Your squad finally reaches Dieppe, a city torn apart by fire and steel. British and Canadian forces are locked in a brutal fight for every block. You’re exhausted, but your orders are clear: hold this ground until the main army arrive. For this final event you will be getting some reinforcements.

Options.Text: Join the assault and push through enemy positions!
